question:
Interchanging the places of which two numbers in the given equation will make the equation balanced?

7 × 10 ÷ 6 + 3 - 2 = 10
solution:
We apply each option to the given equation & solve it using the BODMAS rule:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2f64c9f79d77b59f47195df405b394d1389881df31e18c68888ff4c37e1e42e.png] 

Given: 7 × 10 ÷ 6 + 3 - 2 = 10
Option 1) 6, 10

After interchanging: 7 × __**6 ÷ 10**__ + 3 - 2 = 10

__**7 × 0.**____6__ + 3 - 2 = 10

4.2&
